name: Your own WireGuard VPN
summary: Your own VPN on a small rented computer. Safer public Wi-Fi, or reach your home computer from anywhere.
gains: Great for reaching your home server remotely
tradeoffs: Your VPN server host can still see traffic
Won't hide you like a big shared VPN does
setupSteps: Install WireGuard with a helper like wg-easy (Docker)
Scan the QR code with the WireGuard phone app
